audit.why: Level chart already agrees between full (phases[N].side) and content (win[N]) on all 7 rows, and matches the packet levelChart and the mirror audit (tryndamere__zaahen). Difficulty 7.5/10 is consistent with 51.76% WR over 1136 games — a coinflip lane where tracking one cooldown decides it.
audit.corrected: No chart flips proposed; mirror already realigned rows 1 and 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the ultimates but never gave a single real cooldown number, so 'time your all-in around Undying Rage' had nothing concrete behind it.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and lasts 5s; Spinning Slash is 12/11/10/9/8s. Those numbers turn the advice into a plan.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and spikes[1].text now carry the 12s Spinning Slash and the 5s/120s Undying Rage windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout was described as a flat move-speed cut ('cut your MS and prevent your escape'); Riot's text slows only enemies with their backs turned. Zaahen's W pull (850 range) versus Spinning Slash escape was never stated. wants.foe[0] used the fabricated 'Build Fury' for the passive Battle Fury.
audit.why: Turning to run is what makes Mocking Shout a slow — disengaging while facing him removes the slow entirely and only the AD reduction applies. His only mobility is Spinning Slash, target-required, 12s at rank 1; Zaahen's W drags him back out of it.
audit.corrected: Renamed Battle Fury, restated Mocking Shout's back-turned condition, and added the W pull as the answer to his escape.
sources: brief enemyKit W/E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed no numbers and referred to 'your committal tool' generically.
audit.why: The punishable window is the 120s after Undying Rage and the 12s after Spinning Slash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was asserted as a rule with no mechanism attached.
audit.why: Bloodlust is a 12s cooldown heal that consumes his Fury bar; Grievous Wounds timing is what decides extended trades (flagged in missingInteractions as needs-antiheal).
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the 12s heal and the Executioner's timing.

edits.before: Level 6 is even/skill — your R can beat his all-in only if you time it around Undying Rage's expiry.
edits.after: Level 6 is even/skill — Undying Rage runs 5s on a 120s cooldown, so ult as it expires, not into it.

edits.before: Tryndamere spikes at 3 once Spinning Slash (E) and Mocking Shout are up — his crit-fueled autos and Bloodlust healing win extended trades, and E is his gap-close and escape, so don't trade into a full Fury bar.
edits.after: Tryndamere spikes at 3 with Spinning Slash (E, 12s) and Mocking Shout — crits plus Bloodlust win long trades. Mocking Shout only slows you if your back is turned, so back off facing him, and never trade into a full Fury bar.

edits.before: Your R Final Retribution is the answer to Undying Rage (his R): time your all-in so his Undying window expires while your ult is still healing and draining him, and he can't simply crit you down through it.
edits.after: Your R answers Undying Rage (120/100/80s): let the 5s of immunity burn on nothing, then ult as it ends — your R heals off the damage while he has only Bloodlust left to live on for the next two minutes.

edits.before: Build Fury then E-in for a crit-heavy all-in
edits.after: Stack Battle Fury then E-in for a crit all-in

edits.before: Mocking Shout to cut your MS and prevent your escape
edits.after: Mocking Shout to cut your AD and slow you as you turn

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Combo after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable 5s, then 120s of nothing. Combo as it expires, never into it.

edits.before: Probe Tryndamere's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Bloodlust is a 12s heal off his Fury bar — get Executioner's up before any long trade or his sustain outlasts your Q healing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Damage into Undying Rage is free Fury for him — wait out the 5s.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Spinning Slash needs a target and is 12s at rank 1 — chase past the wave and you hand him the reset back.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Combo after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Undying Rage: 120/100/80s, unkillable for 5s — combo as it expires, never into it. - Spinning Slash: 12s at rank 1 and his only escape. - Your W: 850-range pull drags him back out of it. - Your R: kill windows only.

notes: packet suspectName 'Undying Rage's' is a FALSE POSITIVE (possessive form of the real R). 'Build Fury' was genuine — the passive is Battle Fury; fixed. Zaahen's own ability names used in content prose ('Darkin Glaive', 'Golden Onslaught', 'Final Retribution') are NOT in the kit file (ownerKit carries text only, no names), so I could not verify them and left them alone except where the sentence read better without — see unverified.
